summary: Iteration 87: condominio invoicing (CF only), sostituto d'imposta 4% ritenuta at collection (PaymentDialog + Prima nota IncassoSheet), bonus edilizi bonifico parlante Causale, TD17 cedente nazione regression. Backend: new pytest suite 11/11 pass + iteration86 suite 13/13 pass (TD17 mixed IT/DE -> cedente DE confirmed). Frontend: PartyDialog switches/hint/validation, invoice editor bonus select + causale preview, print page bonifico box, PaymentDialog ritenuta pre-fill (40 on 1000 imponibile, importo 1180) and IncassoSheet ritenuta box (80 on 2000, proportional 40 for half) all working; entries verified in DB (Dare banca tot-rit, Dare 05.02.003 rit, Avere 05.01.001 tot). Two minor backend bugs found.

minor.issue: With condominio=true and persona='fisica' (e.g. existing persona fisica toggled via API), the fisica branch runs first and overwrites denominazione with 'Cognome Nome' (and keeps nome/cognome); only afterwards persona is forced to 'giuridica'. Reproduced: payload denominazione 'TEST_T87 Condominio Via Roma ..', persona fisica, nome Mario cognome Rossi -> saved as 'Rossi Mario' persona giuridica. Fix: move the condominio -> persona='giuridica' forcing before the persona branch.

add_payment with ritenuta_subita creates a second linked 'ritenuta' payment but no link field; deleting the bonifico payment leaves the orphan ritenuta payment (40 EUR) still reducing residuo. Reproduced. Fix: store e.g. parent_payment_id on the ritenuta row and cascade delete (or delete both together).

ui_bugs.issue: payment-ritenuta-check onChange is async (awaits GET /invoices/{id}) so the controlled checkbox reverts until the fetch completes; Playwright .check() fails ('did not change its state'), click()+wait works. Cosmetic flicker; consider setting conRit:true synchronously then fetching imponibile.
ritMan (manual ritenuta override) is never reset when party or invoice selection changes, so a manually typed value persists stale after changing selection.

action_items: PartyIn validator: force persona='giuridica' for condominio BEFORE the persona fisica branch so denominazione isn't overwritten
Cascade-delete the linked 'ritenuta' payment when deleting its incasso (add parent link)
Optional: PaymentDialog ritenuta checkbox set checked synchronously; IncassoSheet reset ritMan on party/selection change
Optional: PaymentDialog ritenuta box is shown for every client (not only sostituto_imposta) and for partite_aperte (storico) GET /invoices/{id} 404 -> no prefill
critical_code_review_comments: server.py add_payment: ritenuta row note hardcoded 'Ritenuta 4% subita dal condominio' regardless of client type
PaymentDialog fetches /invoices/{id} for imponibile; for partite_aperte (opening balances) this 404s silently
